# ---- Start buttons of the new nodes ----
custom_button = {
	name = DA_PR_start_Wardcraft
	tooltip = DA_PR_tt.Wardcraft
	potential = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_PR_selected value = 38 } NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_research_in_progress } }
	trigger = {
		DA_available_research = yes
		DA_completed.Magic_Theory_1 = yes
		DA_completed.Alchemy_1 = yes
		DA_PR_todo.Wardcraft = yes
	}
	effect = {
		DA_start_research = {
			flag = PR_Wardcraft
			time = 72
			arcane = yes
			unstoppable = yes
		}
		hidden_effect = { if = { limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_PR_queued value = 38 } } set_variable = { which = DA_PR_queued value = 0 } } }
	}
}

# ---- Research queue ----
custom_button = {
	name = DA_PR_queue_button
	tooltip = DA_PR_queue_button_tt
	potential = { has_country_flag = DA_research_in_progress check_variable = { which = DA_PR_selected value = 1 } }
	trigger = {
		custom_trigger_tooltip = { tooltip = DA_PR_queue_open_tt DA_PR_selected_is_open = yes }
		custom_trigger_tooltip = { tooltip = DA_PR_queue_not_queued_tt NOT = { DA_PR_selected_is_queued = yes } }
	}
	effect = {
		custom_tooltip = DA_PR_queue_effect_tt
		hidden_effect = { set_variable = { which = DA_PR_queued which = DA_PR_selected } }
	}
}
custom_text_box = {
	name = DA_PR_queued_name
	tooltip = DA_PR_queued_name_tt
	potential = { check_variable = { which = DA_PR_queued value = 1 } }
}
custom_button = {
	name = DA_PR_queue_clear
	tooltip = DA_PR_queue_clear_tt
	potential = { check_variable = { which = DA_PR_queued value = 1 } }
	effect = { hidden_effect = { set_variable = { which = DA_PR_queued value = 0 } } }
}
